his_implied_fp_mass_share_pct.note: His quoted 11 percent for the region past shell 3 sits between the two readings of his own rows, 10.32 for shells 4 and 5 together and 12.04 for everything past shell 3, so it holds. Both are per-volume medians, formed on each volume and reduced afterwards. Subtracting the first three shell medians from 100 instead gives 13.76, which is not a median of anything, so it is not reported here.
